# intel — 2016 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 30 intel CVEs of 2016 are in `data/cve/vendors/intel/2016.jsonl`.

### CVE-2016-8016
- Assigner: intel | Published: 2017-03-14 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: Information exposure
- Exploit-DB 40911: McAfee Virus Scan Enterprise for Linux 1.9.2 < 2.0.2 - Remote Code Execution (remote/linux, 2016-12-13, verified=1)

Information exposure in Intel Security VirusScan Enterprise Linux (VSEL) 2.0.3 (and earlier) allows authenticated remote attackers to obtain the existence of unauthorized files on the system via a URL parameter.

Affected:
- Intel / VirusScan Enterprise Linux (VSEL): affected 2.0.3 (and earlier)
